geometry_scope: All proposed geometry constructed in memory only; original CAD and STEP untouched.
limits: Switch travel is provisional and inferred from comparable parts, not verified for purchased switch.
Hardware envelopes omit thread and socket details and represent conservative M2 pan-head screw geometry.
VRML-derived models contain open presentation surfaces; zero distance requires surface-penetration interpretation.
Zshift variants change cup floor and shelf elevations while preserving its lid contact face at Z24; corresponding nuts follow the cup underside.
Pan-head tops are only 0.08 mm below the resting plunger top, and stand 0.37 mm above it at full provisional depression; finger access is not represented by CAD.

lug_material_webs.method: Exact distance between final cup section wires at Z23, flange cavity and M2 clearance holes.
lug_material_webs.minimum_required_feature_here: 1.2 mm web between each M2 clearance bore and flange cavity; printing strength is not proven by geometric distance.

screw_head_access_at_stop.limits: No particular screwdriver or finger is specified. Theoretical tool diameter is radial geometric access only; use a smaller tool for working clearance. Pan-head envelopes do not directly conflict with the depressed plunger.
